Same record: nothing sent by the rider before 22:04:05 [F10] other than the 21:33 message [F8], and the driver named no alternative road before the deviation [F9]; his post-trip accident explanation [F11] is a claim, not rider consent, and it is unbacked for this stretch (F14 marked ✗). The 3.85 extra km count under RD-1 and are refundable under RD-2.

We're refunding $15.20 to you as a Ryde voucher for two segments of your trip where the driver went off the route without a valid reason and the meter kept running. That's the extra distance charge you paid and shouldn't have. No action is needed from you — the voucher will be applied to your Ryde account, and your fare otherwise stands.

We've refunded $15.20 to the rider as a Ryde voucher and recorded a route-breach on your record. Because you have no prior upheld route dispute, this does not change your account status — no flag was applied. Please follow the suggested route on future trips.
